messages:
maria: Quick sync 1 PR #5202 flagged a confusing bit in the OpenAPI samples for /v1/generate: the schema marks `top_p` as nullable but all examples show it omitted or as number. New users copy-pasting examples hit a validation error when runtime rejects null explicitly. cc @jay @oan

jay: thanks. Which files are inconsistent?

maria: docs/openapi/generate_openapi.json, docs/samples/generate_examples.json, snippets/python/generate_quickstart.md. The OpenAPI schema allowed `top_p: null` but the example used `top_p: null` (literal) and our runtime treats absence and explicit null differently.

oan: ugh. We should pick one canonical contract: runtime expects top_p to be non-null when present (number 0..1) or omitted. So update schema to disallow null for top_p and adjust examples to use numeric values or omit field. Add a migration note for clients that send `null` today.

docs-bot: CI: sample-validator error docs/samples/generate_examples.json line 22: `top_p` value null does not match schema (expected number).

jay: plan: 1) change OpenAPI schema so `top_p` type is number (no null). 2) update examples to either include a numeric `top_p: 0.9` or remove it. 3) add a short migration header in generate.md: "Previously nullable fields (top_p) should now be omitted or sent as a number. Migrate any `null` values."

maria: I'll update examples and quickstart snippets to show explicit numeric values and add the migration blurb. @oan can you update the OpenAPI JSON schema?

oan: will do. Pushing branch `docs/generate-top_p-nullability-3932100000` with commits `schema-no-null-top_p` and `examples-use-numbers`.

docs-bot: Preview build queued after push.

maria: small nit: update language in snippets to mention that omission uses server defaults. e.g., "omit top_p to use default sampling".

jay: after CI passes, please add changelog: "docs: make top_p non-nullable in OpenAPI; update examples and quickstart snippets". Also notify SDK owners so they can adjust validators.

oan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5202. CI green.

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/docs/5202

maria: verified preview and quickstart. Closing thread."
